items.difficulty_reason: 76 行的等价链证明：五条范畴之间的四段等价，每段都把「用哪个引理、以什么条件适用」写清楚。最有实质的一段是 (3)↔(4)：要取基与预层子范畴、用两层描述（Descent 的局部化条件与 chaotic 拓扑下的拟凝聚性）认出该子范畴，再逐条验证比较引理的四个条件（前层、弱 Serre 子范畴、基覆盖、仿射上高次上同调消没）。承重步骤（适用性设置与四个条件的验证）都在 span 内；9 处引用全部跨章（Descent/Modules on Sites/Cohomology on Sites/Schemes/Cohomology of Schemes），作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-DQCoh-alternative-small (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 11001-11012

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the comparison of the Zariski site with the ringed space, the equivalence of the affine site with the Zariski site through the notion of quasi-coherent modules, and the verification of the four conditions that let the comparison lemma for adequate modules produce the last equivalence (source lines 11014-11089)
